import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem coprime_base_pow_sub_one {a n : ℕ} (ha : a > 1) (hn : 0 < n) : Nat.Coprime a (a ^ n - 1) := by
  have hd : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ 1 := by
    have h1 : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (a ^ n - 1)
    have h2 : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a ^ n - 1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a (a ^ n - 1)
    have h_pow : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a ^ n := dvd_pow h1 hn.ne'
    have h_le : 1 ≤ a ^ n := Nat.one_le_pow n a (by omega)
    have h_eq : a ^ n = (a ^ n - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have h_pow' : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ (a ^ n - 1) + 1 := by rwa [h_eq] at h_pow
    exact (Nat.dvd_add_right h2).mp h_pow'
  exact Nat.dvd_one.mp hd

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem coprime_base_pow_sub_one {a n : ℕ} (ha : a > 1) (hn : 0 < n) : Nat.Coprime a (a ^ n - 1) := by
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := by omega
  have h_pow_pos : 0 < a ^ n := Nat.pow_pos ha_pos
  have h_a_dvd_pow : a ∣ a ^ n := by
    cases n with
    | zero => omega
    | succ n => exact ⟨a ^ n, by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]⟩
  have hg_dvd_a : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a := Nat.gcd_dvd_left a (a ^ n - 1)
  have hg_dvd_sub : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ (a ^ n - 1) := Nat.gcd_dvd_right a (a ^ n - 1)
  have hg_dvd_pow : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a ^ n := dvd_trans hg_dvd_a h_a_dvd_pow
  have hg_dvd_one : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ 1 := by
    have h_dvd : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a ^ n - (a ^ n - 1) := Nat.dvd_sub hg_dvd_pow hg_dvd_sub
    have heq : a ^ n - (a ^ n - 1) = 1 := by omega
    rwa [heq] at h_dvd
  exact (Nat.dvd_one.mp hg_dvd_one)

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem coprime_base_pow_sub_one {a n : ℕ} (ha : a > 1) (hn : 0 < n) : Nat.Coprime a (a ^ n - 1) := by
  rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]
  let g := Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1)
  
  have hga : g ∣ a := Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  have hgb : g ∣ a ^ n - 1 := Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
  
  have hpow : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → g ∣ a ^ k := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ :=
      Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt hk)
    rw [pow_succ]
    exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hga _
  
  have hgpow : g ∣ a ^ n := hpow n hn
  
  have hgone : g ∣ 1 := by
    have h := Nat.dvd_sub hgpow hgb
    have hp : 0 < a ^ n := pow_pos (by omega) _
    convert h using 1 <;> omega
  
  exact Nat.dvd_one.mp hgone

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000

open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem coprime_base_pow_sub_one {a n : ℕ} (ha : a > 1) (hn : 0 < n) : Nat.Coprime a (a ^ n - 1) := by
  rw [Nat.coprime_iff_gcd_eq_one]
  apply Nat.dvd_one.mp
  have hga : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a :=
    Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _
  have hgb : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a ^ n - 1 :=
    Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _
  have hpow : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a ^ n :=
    dvd_pow hga (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  have hdiff : Nat.gcd a (a ^ n - 1) ∣ a ^ n - (a ^ n - 1) :=
    Nat.dvd_sub hpow hgb
  have hpos : 0 < a ^ n :=
    Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
  have heq : a ^ n - (a ^ n - 1) = 1 := by
    omega
  rw [heq] at hdiff
  exact hdiff

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem coprime_base_pow_sub_one {a n : ℕ} (ha : a > 1) (hn : 0 < n) : Nat.Coprime a (a ^ n - 1) := by
  have ha_pos : 0 < a := lt_trans Nat.zero_lt_one ha
  have ha_pow : a ∣ a ^ n := dvd_pow_self a (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)
  have hle : 1 ≤ a ^ n := Nat.one_le_pow n a ha_pos
  have hsum : (a ^ n - 1) + 1 = a ^ n := Nat.sub_add_cancel hle
  have hcop_pow : Nat.Coprime (a ^ n - 1) (a ^ n) := by
    have hcop_succ :
        Nat.Coprime (a ^ n - 1) ((a ^ n - 1) + 1) := by
      rw [Nat.coprime_self_add_right]
      exact Nat.coprime_one_right _
    rw [← hsum]
    exact hcop_succ
  have hcop_a : Nat.Coprime (a ^ n - 1) a :=
    Nat.Coprime.of_dvd_right ha_pow hcop_pow
  exact hcop_a.symm
